0022600127.text: The Golden State Warriors (0-3, 4th in the Pacific, 3 games back, 14th in the West) visit the Denver Nuggets (1-1, 4th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, 7th in the West) in the fourth game of the 2026-27 season. Golden State is on a three-game losing streak and 0-2 on the road, while Denver is 1-0 at home and has won its last game, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with Denver winning 116-93 in their most recent meeting on March 29. For the Warriors, Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee, surgery) are out, and Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee) and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) are day-to-day with game-time decisions; for the Nuggets, Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are out, and Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) are day-to-day with game-time decisions.
